@eng-77 Re ROUTEKIT-115: from the design review I attended — a closure blocks the physical road in both directions, whichever way round it is written: ("HAM","BER") removes the record ("BER","HAM",289), and in a directed network a closure removes both the A->B and the B->A records. So after closing BER-HAM, KIE should still be reachable if there's another path; if not, KIE is isolated. The test expecting ['HAM','KIE'] is the correct one.
